00_baseline.title: Baseline
00_baseline.change: Calibration as it stood before this work.

01_ambiguous_angle_band.title: Ambiguous-angle band
01_ambiguous_angle_band.change: Lines 24-40 degrees from horizontal are offered as both baseline and sideline candidates instead of being split at a fixed 32 degrees.

02_x_refine_top8.title: Refine top 8 candidates (rejected)
02_x_refine_top8.change: Refine the 8 best candidate courts instead of only the best one, and keep the best refined score.

03_band_lines_fill_leftover_slots.title: Band lines fill leftover slots
03_band_lines_fill_leftover_slots.change: Lines from the ambiguous band only fill line slots that unambiguous lines leave free.

04_refine_outline_guard.title: Refinement outline guard
04_refine_outline_guard.change: Each refinement step must still produce a plausible court outline.

05_score_partially_visible_courts.title: Score partially visible courts
05_score_partially_visible_courts.change: A court with up to 40% of its markings outside the frame is scored on its visible markings, with a proportional penalty; corners may lie further outside the frame.

06_vanishing_point_line_families.title: Vanishing-point line families
06_vanishing_point_line_families.change: Lines are also grouped by the vanishing point they run towards, not only by their angle in the image.

07_x_refine_with_far_half.title: Refine against far half too (rejected)
07_x_refine_with_far_half.change: Half-court fits are refined against far-half markings that are in view as well.

08_stricter_bar_for_partial_views.title: Stricter bar for partial views
08_stricter_bar_for_partial_views.change: A partially visible court must reach a raw score of 0.6 before it is considered.
